test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 12 people can print 540 identical books in 10 days, then how many more people will be required to print 720 such books in 8 days?
solution:
**Given:**

12 people can print 540 identical books in 10 days

**Formula used:**

Work Done (W) = Number of People (P) × Number of Days (D)

**Calculation:**

First, find the work rate of 12 people:

W = P × D

⇒ W = 12 × 10

⇒ W = 120 people-days to print 540 books
